due_when.clears_when: the census honours --since-days on dump input and closed_at is ISO on every closed trades row, or both are killed with a stated reason

origin.rerun: python3 scripts/research/giveback_census.py --telemetry-file <tele.json> --trades-file <trades.json> --since-days 7 --min-n 10 --unit X --out /tmp/x  # n_graded must differ from --since-days 90

what: [performance] Two small tooling defects found while running the 10-21 census: (1) scripts/research/giveback_census.py ignores --since-days on the --trades-file/--telemetry-file path (identical n for 7/30/90); (2) trades.id 6131 has closed_at stored as epoch-ms string '1790835474843' while 1,544 other non-null values are ISO, so a lexical date filter drops it. See docs/reviews/2026-10-21-weekly-walkthrough.md (PR #19362).
